item.title: Yuxi Xie Defends Her Ph.D. Thesis on Closed-Loop Scaling
item.description:
Congratulations to Yuxi Xie on successfully defending her Ph.D. thesis, “Closed Loop Scaling: Autonomous Improvement of LLM and VLM Reasoning”, from WING!

We wish her every success as she moves into her next chapter.

Many thanks to her committee members, Zhiyong Huang, Anthony K. H. Tung, and See-Kiong Ng, and to her many collaborators, including Michael Shieh, Junxian He, and Kenji Kawaguchi.

Special thanks as well to Prof. William Wang for hosting Yuxi at the University of California, Santa Barbara.
